{{Quote|The ''Aggressor''{{'s}} their headquarters. You've seen it&mdash;a crashed ship Margok turned into a fortress. Can't get in without the proper security codes.|[[Theron Shan]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Aggressor''''' was the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang. The ship crashed on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] some years before [[3637 BBY]], leaving its crew stranded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Over time the pirates were able to return to the space and made Rishi their new base of operations in the western mountains of [[Horizon Island]], converting the crashed hull of the ''Aggressor'' into a social and storage hub, which included living quarters, manufactories, security stations and more.
